sections.content: Use si + imperfect subjunctive + conditional to describe a hypothetical situation: Si ocurriera X, haríamos Y. The condition is presented as uncertain or contrary to the current situation.

items.spanish: Si ocurriera algo inesperado, buscaríamos otra solución.
items.english: If something unexpected happened, we would look for another solution.

items.spanish: Si dependiera de mí, cambiaría el plan.
items.english: If it depended on me, I would change the plan.

items.spanish: Si tuviéramos más información, podríamos decidir mejor.
items.english: If we had more information, we could decide better.

items.spanish: Si la hipótesis fuera correcta, el resultado sería diferente.
items.english: If the hypothesis were correct, the outcome would be different.

sections.content: Do not use the conditional directly after si in this pattern: si ocurriera, haríamos, not si ocurriría.
